Omar (AE): Customer asks for a BYO-HSM POC + a scripted zero-downtime rotation demo. They also want a clear pricing delta vs Dedicated and a 2yr audit-retention option.
Lin (SalesEng): I'll draft pricing bands: connector engineering, monthly HSM ops, per-crypto-op surcharge, rotation rehearsal line-item, and 2yr/3yr audit retention tiers.
Vik (SRE): Need HSM model and expected per-op latencies. For 100 TPS we recommend either batching or ephemeral wrapping to avoid 100 HSM roundtrips/sec.
Rosa (Security): Must have hardware attestation certs, signed provenance for key imports, and signed rotation audit bundles. Incident notif SLA <=2 hours.
Omar (AE): Procurement also wants milestone payments tied to connector completion and POC acceptance. Any sample acceptance bullets?
Lin (SalesEng): Proposed SOW acceptance: 1) successful encrypt/decrypt on bridged keys for 60m, 2) rotation dry-run with zero 5xx for 30m, 3) sustained 100 TPS with <75ms added crypto latency, 4) signed audit bundle delivered to customer S3 on rotation.
Vik (SRE): Sample dry-run command we can include:
./hsm-rotate --env=staging --endpoint=vpn://10.8.1.2 --key=demo-01 --mode=dryrun --verify-audit
ops-bot: Uploaded draft SOW https://redwood.internal/sow/1744449999. Please review by EOD PST.
Lin (SalesEng): I'll send pricing sketches + SOW bullets by EOD. Vik, can you run a short latency sim tomorrow and share numbers?
Vik (SRE): Yep — ping me for access to the sim results.
